units.characteristics: the crushing weight and fixity of folly
units.gist: a fool's provocation heavier than stone/sand; crush a fool in a mortar, his folly won't depart - folly as ineradicable (w/ 26:11)

units.characteristics: appetite conditioned by fullness/hunger
units.gist: the full loathe honey, the hungry find bitter sweet - the state of the self colours the object (w/ Ecc 6:7)

units.characteristics: the displaced strayer; the near friend over the distant brother
units.gist: a man who strays from home like a bird from its nest; do not forsake your friend, a near neighbour better than a far brother (w/ 18:24)

units.characteristics: the child's wisdom gladdening and vindicating the parent
units.gist: be wise my son and make my heart glad, that I may answer him who reproaches me (glad pole, thread w/ 10:1, 23:24)

units.characteristics: foresight that takes cover; faithful service rewarded
units.gist: the prudent sees danger and hides; tending the fig tree eats its fruit, guarding the master is honoured (w/ 22:3)

units.characteristics: over-loud praise as curse; the ungovernable contentious
units.gist: blessing loudly early counted as cursing; restraining the contentious woman = restraining the wind (w/ 21:9)

units.characteristics: attentive stewardship against impermanent riches
units.gist: know well the condition of your flocks, for riches do not last forever; enough milk for the household - care over hoarding (w/ Ecc)

units.characteristics: the surety-snare
units.gist: take a man's garment when he has put up security for a stranger (thread w/ 6:1-5, 17:18, 22:26)

units.characteristics: the public atmosphere set by righteous/wicked rule
units.gist: a transgressing land has many rulers vs stability under understanding; righteous triumph = glory, wicked rise = people hide (thread w/ 29:2)

units.characteristics: the law and the hearing (or turned-away) ear; unheard law makes prayer abomination
units.gist: forsaking the law praises the wicked; keeping it = an understanding son; turning the ear from the law makes even prayer an abomination

units.characteristics: seeking-God as the key to understanding justice
units.gist: evil men do not understand justice, but those who seek the LORD understand it completely (w/ Job 28:28)

units.characteristics: the two ways; the pit-digger self-trapped
units.gist: better poor-with-integrity than rich-crooked; misleading the upright falls into his own pit; integrity delivered, the crooked suddenly falls (w/ Ps 7:15)

units.characteristics: greedy haste self-defeating; the rich self-deceived; generosity the un-wanting path
units.gist: wealth by interest gathers for the generous; the rich wise in his own eyes; hastening/stingy after wealth -> poverty; giving to the poor -> not want (w/ Ecc 5:10, 11:24)

units.characteristics: the predatory ruler; hating unjust gain as what preserves
units.gist: a wicked ruler over the poor = a roaring lion/charging bear; the understanding-lacking ruler a cruel oppressor, but he who hates unjust gain prolongs his days

units.characteristics: guilt's lifelong flight; cheap corruption; the self-justified thief
units.gist: burdened with blood -> fugitive till death; partiality for a piece of bread; robbing parents and calling it no transgression = kin to a destroyer (w/ Gen 4:12)

units.characteristics: honest rebuke outlasting flattery
units.gist: whoever rebukes will afterward find more favour than the flatterer (thread w/ 27:5-6)

units.characteristics: the people's joy/groaning under just/unjust rule; faithful judgment establishes
units.gist: righteous increase = people rejoice, wicked rule = groan; justice builds the land; a king who judges the poor faithfully, his throne endures (thread w/ 28:12)

units.characteristics: the snare of one's own sin vs the freed song; the mutual abomination of the two ways
units.gist: the evil ensnared in his transgression, the righteous sings and rejoices; the unjust an abomination to the righteous, the straight to the wicked (w/ 5:22)

units.characteristics: discipline yielding rest and delight; the will words alone cannot move
units.gist: loving wisdom gladdens the father; the rod gives wisdom, the un-disciplined child shames; discipline -> rest and delight; a servant not moved by mere words

units.characteristics: knowing the poor's rights as righteousness; justice from God over the ruler's face
units.gist: the righteous knows the rights of the poor, the wicked does not; many seek the ruler's face, but justice is from the LORD (w/ 28:5)

units.characteristics: the scoffer as fire-setter; the futility of arguing with a raging fool; the hasty tongue
units.gist: scoffers set a city aflame, the wise turn wrath; a fool only rages and laughs, no quiet; the hasty in words - more hope for a fool (w/ 15:1, Ecc 5:2)

units.characteristics: hatred of the blameless; the ruler's ear corrupting the court; complicity as self-hatred
units.gist: bloodthirsty hate the blameless; a ruler who listens to falsehood breeds wicked officials; the thief's partner hates his own life

units.characteristics: vision/law as what restrains the self
units.gist: where there is no vision the people cast off restraint; blessed is he who keeps the law (thread w/ 28:9)

units.characteristics: taking refuge in the proven word of God
units.gist: every word of God proves true; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him (quotes Ps 18:30 - the trust/refuge cluster)

units.characteristics: the mocking eye that scorns a parent; the dishonoured parent
units.gist: do not slander a servant; those who curse fathers and do not bless mothers; the eye that mocks a father, picked out by ravens (w/ 6:17; inverts the honour thread)

units.characteristics: owned wonder at the unsearchable; the way of love; the destabilising reversal
units.gist: three/four things too wonderful (the way of a man with a virgin); the earth trembles under reversals (the long-unloved wed, the maid displacing her mistress) (w/ Job 42:3)

units.characteristics: wisdom-in-the-small (foresight and security without strength)
units.gist: four small but exceedingly wise: the ants provide food in summer (foresight), the badgers home in the cliffs (security) (w/ 6:6)
